name: retrospective
description: Structured project retrospective — mines agent sessions, audits git + plans, cross-checks epistemic layers, and can identify repeated workflows worth packaging as skills, custom agents, or automations. Claude/Codex-friendly and project-agnostic. Use for /retrospective, retro, look-backs, or workflow-packaging requests.
